novelty_flags.label: Theorems 1, 2, and 4 related-work survey
novelty_flags.one_line: The survey misses Chen et al. (ICML 2025), which identifies mixed-type discrete latent causal structures under completeness and a two-sufficient-measurement condition and is a closer categorical tensor-rank comparator.

soundness_flags.label: ass:double-triangular
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited Lee--Gu result is explicitly binary; its categorical appendix says V>2 needs additional alternating-polynomial nonvanishing, so the q-state variant must be retagged novel and independently justified.

soundness_flags.label: def:ternary-witness / prop:ternary-witness
soundness_flags.one_line: The declared 8-by-3 Gamma-star is written as the transpose of eight displayed triples, while P-star quantifies h as a scalar in {0,1,2} although h must lie in {0,1,2}^3; repair these dimensions before the determinant claim is meaningful.

soundness_flags.label: K_min and C_K definitions / Theorem 4
soundness_flags.one_line: C_K(P_X) ranges over realizations satisfying undefined 'standard model conditions', so the claimed universal same-K quotient statement has no fixed alternative-model domain.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:2505.18410v2, 31 January 2026; accessible version differs from the bibliography's claimed TMLR version
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorems 1--2 concern binary latent variables; Appendix G states that for V>2 nonzero alternating polynomials must additionally be assumed and gives the V=3,K=J=2 obstruction.

source_verification_receipts.version: Annals of Statistics 37(6A), 2009 author-hosted article PDF
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper derives generic latent-structure identifiability by grouping observables into three conditionally independent views and applying Kruskal's theorem; it assumes the number of latent classes known in its finite-state applications.

The constructive tensor-unfolding result identifies the Q-matrix from population ranks on a parameter space containing two identity submatrices, i.e. two pure items per attribute; it also treats polytomous responses.
Theorem 3.2 reconstructs Gamma and P(H) from P(X) plus MixOracle under no-twins, maximality, nondegeneracy, and subset conditions; its constructive recovery is oracle-mediated.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Retag q-state double triangularity as novel, state an explicit openness/density argument for the certificate within the positive categorical-table parameter space, and distinguish it from Lee--Gu's binary condition.

Add Chen et al. (ICML 2025) as a named comparator and state precisely whether the certified double-triangular class is incomparable with, contains, or is excluded by its completeness/two-sufficient-measurement class.
Make C_K a fully enumerated alternative-model class and repair the Gamma-star orientation and H=h in Q^3 notation; then give the witness's selected B matrices explicitly.

recommended_next_step: Revise the categorical-assumption status, alternative-model domain, witness notation, and literature comparison, then advance the repaired field-tier kernel to Stage 0.
